Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking a Senior Manager, International Facilities to lead facility operations across a rapidly expanding national portfolio. The role is accountable for the performance of international (non-U.S.) sites after project turnover, including regional and site operations, maintenance and asset reliability, workplace services, vendor delivery, budgets, customer experience, and operational risk. 

This is a hands-on leadership role. The successful candidate will establish clear regional accountability, standardize service delivery without losing local responsiveness, develop internal talent, and build strong operating partnerships with Manufacturing, Engineering, Px, IT, EH&S, Security, Real Estate, Capital Delivery, Finance, and Procurement. The leader must be equally comfortable in an executive review, on a manufacturing floor, and in a facility incident response. 


What you'll do:
INTERNATIONAL AND REGIONAL OPERATIONS LEADERSHIP 
  • Own day-to-day and lifecycle performance across the international facilities portfolio after formal project turnover. 
  • Establish and lead a regional operating model across company regions with clear site accountability and escalation paths. 
  • Develop annual site operating plans, service models, staffing approaches, and priorities based on site tier, mission criticality, hours of operation, and risk. 
  • Serve as the senior international escalation point for facility reliability, workplace service, landlord, vendor, and site-continuity issues. 
    • RELIABILITY, MAINTENANCE, AND ASSET MANAGEMENT 
  • Establish consistent asset registers, preventive-maintenance programs, work-order practices, critical-spares strategies, and lifecycle-risk visibility. 
  • Set and monitor service levels for critical systems, maintenance, employee requests, and workplace services. 
  • Identify infrastructure risks early and develop operating, maintenance, or capital recommendations with the appropriate functional owner. 
  • Drive root-cause analysis and durable corrective action for recurring failures, outages, backlogs, and service issues. 
    • PEOPLE, VENDORS, AND CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE 
  • Lead, coach, and develop regional and site Facilities teammates; establish clear roles, goals, and performance expectations. 
  • Manage IFM and specialist providers through scopes, service levels, scorecards, performance reviews, corrective actions, and renewal recommendations. 
  • Create a consistent workplace and customer-service experience while adapting delivery to manufacturing, engineering, office, hangar, and classified environments. 
  • Build trusted relationships with site leaders and business partners; translate business demand into clear operating plans and service requirements. 
    • FINANCIAL AND OPERATIONAL GOVERNANCE 
  • Own the International Facilities operating plan, budget inputs, forecast, variance explanations, and resource recommendations in partnership with the Global Facilities Leader and Finance. 
  • Maintain a site risk register, vendor-performance view, critical-action plan, and forward-looking capacity and lifecycle concerns. 
  • Use common KPIs and operating reviews to manage performance, prioritize resources, and escalate material decisions. 
  • Ensure vendors, purchase orders, invoices, contracts, and operating commitments follow Finance, Procurement, and delegation requirements. 
    • LIFECYCLE INTEGRATION AND RISK PARTNERSHIP 
  • Provide operational requirements during site selection, design, and project delivery; participate in design reviews, commissioning, readiness, and move planning. 
  • Formally accept or reject project turnover against documented criteria, then lead post-occupancy stabilization and defect closure. 
  • Partner with EH&S and Security to implement standards, address findings, coordinate incidents, and maintain emergency and continuity readiness. 
  • Coordinate with Real Estate on lease obligations and capacity, while preserving Real Estate ownership of portfolio strategy and transactions. 

    • Required qualifications:
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in facilities management, engineering, operations, construction, business, or a related field. 
  • 12+ years of progressive experience in facilities management, integrated facilities management, corporate real estate operations, engineering operations, or a comparable field. 
  • 5+ years leading complex multi-site or regional operations, including direct people leadership and management of outsourced service providers. 
  • Experience operating facilities that support manufacturing, engineering, laboratories, aviation, critical infrastructure, secure environments, or other technically complex work. 
  • Demonstrated ownership of operating budgets, forecasts, contracts, vendor performance, service levels, and facility risk. 
  • Strong working knowledge of maintenance, building systems, preventive maintenance, work-order management, asset lifecycle, and incident response. 
  • Proven ability to build teams, standardize operations, and drive accountability across geographically dispersed locations. 
  • Executive-level communication and judgment, with the ability to translate technical and operational issues into clear business decisions. 
  • Ability to travel frequently and respond to time-sensitive facility priorities as required. 

    • Preferred qualifications:
  • Experience in aerospace, defense, advanced manufacturing, autonomous systems, technology, or another high-growth regulated environment. 
  • Experience with SCIFs, classified environments, hangars, high-bay spaces, production facilities, or 24/7 critical operations. 
  • Experience establishing a regional operating model or scaling Facilities operations across a rapidly growing portfolio. 
  • Familiarity with CMMS/EAM, IWMS, service-management, building-automation, business-intelligence, and financial systems. 
  • CFM, FMP, CPMM, IFMA, engineering, project-management, or related professional credential. 
  • Experience leading major vendor transitions, IFM sourcing, commissioning, or project turnover. 
  • Current or prior security clearance, or experience operating in controlled-access environments. 

    • What we're looking for:

    The ideal candidate is a visible, credible operations leader who sets high standards and stays close to the work. This person can build structure at national scale while understanding that each site has different mission, technical, workforce, and risk requirements. 

    Success requires calm judgment, customer empathy, technical curiosity, financial discipline, and strong people leadership. The leader should earn trust, put the team first, move with rigor and speed, and make prudent use of internal and external resources.

Career Path 
Your professional development is important to us, so we have laid out a career plan to help you progress towards your goals and objectives.

You'll also play a key role in how we build and scale AI-native ways of working within G&A, identifying where intelligent tooling can sharpen decision-making, accelerate execution, and give the CFO's office a genuine edge. Zwei erfahrene Unternehmer bauen eine Nachfolgeholding für etablierte mittelständische Unternehmen auf, und du bist von Anfang an dabei: von den ersten Investments bis zu konkreten operativen Verbesserungen in unseren Beteiligungen.

Felix hat Arsipa seit 2020 durch Unternehmensnachfolgen und konsequente Digitalisierung zu einer Gruppe mit über 1.000 Mitarbeitenden aufgebaut. 2024 verkaufte er die Gruppe an Warburg Pincus und bleibt als Gesellschafter beteiligt.

Milan hat bei HomeToGo den Aufbau und die internationale Skalierung des Unternehmens mitgeprägt. Anschließend hat er Stellar Trust / Xentra mitgegründet, eine Softwarelösung für Ferienhausagenturen und Hotels.

Du arbeitest direkt an Analysen, Gesprächen und Entscheidungen mit und übernimmst schnell eigene Themen. Der operative Teil ist dabei kein Nebenschauplatz: Für uns beginnt die eigentliche Arbeit nach der Übernahme.

Aufgaben

Investments, ca. 40 %

  • Du identifizierst passende mittelständische Unternehmen und analysierst ihre Märkte, Geschäftsmodelle und Finanzzahlen.

  • Du begleitest Due Diligence, Finanzierung und Transaktionsprozess und bereitest Gespräche mit Unternehmern, Managementteams und Finanzierungspartnern vor. Bei vielen bist du selbst dabei.

Operations, ca. 50 %

  • Du übernimmst konkrete Projekte in unseren Beteiligungen, von der ersten Analyse bis zur Umsetzung mit den Teams vor Ort.
  • Du analysierst Vertriebs-, Kosten- und Prozessdaten und entwickelst daraus Maßnahmen, die anschließend umgesetzt werden.
  • Gemeinsam mit den Teams entwickelst du Vertrieb, Reporting und interne Abläufe weiter.
  • Du findest die Stellen, an denen Software, Daten und KI-gestützte Automatisierung einen echten Unterschied machen, und setzt passende Lösungen mit um.

Interne Themen, ca. 10 %

  • Du gestaltest den weiteren Aufbau von BLNWRK und unserer internen Strukturen mit.
  • Du verbesserst unsere Prozesse, Tools und Datenbanken dort, wo du Potenzial siehst.

Qualifikation

  • Du studierst BWL, VWL, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder etwas Vergleichbares.
  • Du arbeitest analytisch und verlierst auch bei komplexen Themen nicht den Überblick.
  • Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Zahlen und ein echtes Interesse an unternehmerischen Zusammenhängen.

  • Du hast bereits erste praktische Erfahrung gesammelt, etwa in Beratung, Investment Banking, Private Equity, einem Start-up oder einem mittelständischen Unternehmen.
  • Du bist während des Praktikums in Berlin oder bereit, für die Zeit hierherzuziehen.

Du möchtest BLNWRK mit uns aufbauen? Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Sätze dazu, was dich an Unternehmensnachfolgen im Mittelstand interessiert und wie deine Erfahrung dazu passt.

Der Prozess besteht aus drei Schritten: ein erstes Kennenlernen, eine Case Study an einem echten Fall aus unserem Dealflow und ein finales Gespräch, in dem wir deine Ergebnisse gemeinsam durchgehen. Wenn es für beide Seiten passt, ist im Anschluss ein Einstieg in Vollzeit möglich.

jobs.title: (Senior) Account Manager
jobs.description:
Your Impact

We're strong at landing new customers. Now we need to get excellent at growing them.

Expanding within the customer base is one of Tacto's biggest growth levers, and we're building it out for the long term. Most mature B2B companies generate 50%+ of their revenue from existing customers - we want to capture more of that potential, and we're strengthening the team to get there. As Account Manager, you'll be a driving force behind our expansion motion: identifying and closing upsells, cross-sells, and strategic price increases across our customer base, and helping build and sharpen the playbook as we scale it. You'll work between Sales, Customer Value, and Product, spotting growth opportunities and turning them into revenue. This is your chance to build and grow a crucial commercial function at one of Europe's fastest growing industrial AI companies.

Your Tasks

  • Own deals end-to-end: Identify opportunities, build business cases, run negotiations, close deals. Manage contracts and pricing logic.

  • Master account intelligence: Read customer dynamics, map stakeholders, understand politics. Know when to drive expansion yourself vs. when to bring in AEs or Customer Value. Identify perfect timing for upsells.

  • Coordinate across functions: Coordinate with Sales (pipeline), Customer Success (value-delivery), Product (what to sell), and Finance (forecasting) to drive expansion deals

  • Own forecasting and planning: Build accurate expansion forecasts. Coordinate deal timelines. Keep the business informed and on track.

  • Translate roadmap into revenue: Work with Product and Marketing to turn new modules into concrete expansion conversations with the right customers at the right time.

  • Help building the function as it scales: Turn what you learn into reusable process, qualification criteria, pricing guardrails, forecasting templates, rules of engagement with Sales and Customer Value. Where the playbook doesn't exist yet, you help writing it

Your Profile

We're looking for someone who can build, close, and scale. Here's what typically works:

  • 2-4 years in high-performance environments: A proven track record of hitting, and significantly overachieving, quarterly or yearly commercial targets, in account management, sales, or a customer success role with a real commercial component.

  • Proven commercial track record in B2B SaaS companies.

  • Extremely smart and driven – you connect dots quickly, learn fast, and push hard to win

  • Excellent stakeholder management – you navigate complex organizations, build relationships with senior buyers (Heads of Procurement, C-Level), and align internal teams

  • Negotiation toughness – you hold your ground in price discussions without burning bridges

  • Process-oriented – you own details: contracts, terms, renewal dates, forecasting

  • Genuine interest in industrial procurement – you want to understand how manufacturing companies work and speak their language

  • Native German + fluent English

Why This Role is Awesome

This is the first dedicated Account Manager seat at Tacto. Some first structures exist, but most of the function is still yours to build: the quota model, the rules of engagement with Sales and Customer Value, the process itself. Get this right, and expansion becomes Tacto's biggest new revenue lever within two to three years, that's the scale of upside on the table. Do it well for the first 12 to 18 months, and you define your next step: a bigger book of accounts, leading the function as it grows into a full team, or a move into Sales or Customer Value leadership.

What This Role Is - and Isn't

  • This is not customer support with a sales quota bolted on. You'll be measured on revenue, not on being liked, and some weeks that means pushing a commercial conversation the customer wasn't asking for.

  • This is not a mature, handed-to-you playbook. You'll build your own pipeline, your own forecast discipline, and parts of the process itself.

  • Prove you can turn module adoption into signed expansion revenue, and we'll back you owning a bigger book, leading the function, or moving into Sales or CV leadership next.

Why Tacto

  • We bet on young talent and mean it. We consistently back smart, hungry, young people with real ownership early. The large majority of our Leadership Team was promoted internally, you deliver impact and the sky is the limit at Tacto.

  • Backed to win big. We're Sequoia and Index Ventures-funded, with more than €50M raised. We're building Tacto to be the lighthouse for European industrial AI.

  • A truly AI-native organization, with every resource you could dream of. All the leading AI tools and custom agents at your fingertips, plus dedicated people who keep us at the frontier.

  • High bar, high speed, genuinely fun. You'll be surrounded by extremely smart and ambitious people who set the bar high and push you to get better every week. Intense, fast, and the opposite of boring.

  • A front-row seat in the European startup ecosystem. Weekly exposure to leading founders and operators through internal and external events (Lunch & Learns, hackathons, community gatherings). Get a glimpse here: https://luma.com/tacto

  • You'll build something that lasts and that matters. You'll help build the company that keeps European industry competitive for the long term.

Our Background

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

Why It Matters

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI.

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

What We Offer

The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. We have high expectations, great talent density, and a culture where your ambition, performance, and agency are what count - not where you come from or how big your ego is. You'll grow at the forefront of AI, have real ownership and impact, and be surrounded by the best people in their field who challenge you and make you better every day. That is demanding and rewarding, but that's where we thrive. Besides that you have:

  • Money: Competitive salary & equity in the company with real upside, so you are invested in our success

  • Workplace: A vibrant in-office culture (> 4 days/week) in a beautiful office in central Munich

  • Development: A development budget and regular exposure to exceptional people, e.g., Lunch & Learns, peer mentoring, external speakers

  • Time off: 26 + 4 vacation days per year (4 fixed “company rest days”) as well as regular off-sites and team events

  • Health: Wellpass membership, of course, a fruit basket (!), and access to Jobrad, for your health

  • Family & Social Security: Voluntary pension contribution, voluntary KITA subsidy for your children

Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

jobs.description:
palmerhargreaves ist die Agentur für komplexe Themen und Transformationsaufgaben. Inhabergeführt und international präsent, nutzen wir die Kraft von Kreativität, Beziehungen und Technologien, um für Marken und Menschen Resonanz zu erzeugen. Wie keine andere Agentur nutzt palmerhargreaves schon heute alle Möglichkeiten der generativen KI, um die Kommunikation ihrer Kunden noch effizienter und effektiver zu machen. Die Agentur beschäftigt über 100 Mitarbeitende aus 12 Nationen. Zu den Kunden zählen weltbekannte Marken wie Audi, Bayer, Deutsche Telekom, Ford, Henkel und SAP.

Aufgaben

Wenn jemand ChatGPT, Perplexity oder Google AI Overviews nach einer Marke fragt, entscheidet sich in der Antwort, ob diese Marke überhaupt vorkommt – und ob das, was dort über sie steht, stimmt. Wir analysieren das für Konzerne: über fünf KI-Systeme, hunderte Fragen, mehrere Messwellen im Jahr. Aus diesen Rohdaten werden Zahlen, auf die wir Empfehlungen und unsere Kunden Entscheidungen stützen.

Genau da setzt deine Rolle an. Du unterstützt bei Bau und Betreuung der Datenschicht darunter: einlesen, validieren, anreichern, auswertbar machen.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Du entwickelst Skripte, die Rohdaten aus unseren GEO-Messungen einlesen, normalisieren und auf Vollständigkeit prüfen (JavaScript/Node.js, Python)
  • Du bindest APIs an – Suchdaten, KI-Systeme, externe Daten, interne Tools, MCP – inklusive Fehlerbehandlung und Rate Limits
  • Du arbeitest in unserem Google-Cloud-Stack: BigQuery für die Datenhaltung, Looker Studio für die Dashboards, Cloud Functions für alles, was automatisch laufen soll
  • Du automatisierst Qualitätsprüfungen. Die Leitfrage dahinter: Fällt ein inkonsistenter Messlauf auf, bevor er im Kundenreport landet?
  • Du prüfst strukturierte Daten auf Kundenseite (schema.org, JSON-LD, Knowledge-Graph-Einträge) und dokumentierst, wo sie von der Realität abweichen
  • Du dokumentierst, was du baust, so dass es auch ohne dich weiterläuft

Qualifikation

Das bringst du idealerweise mit:

  • Du hast Spaß an der Arbeit mit Daten, Zusammenhängen, Automationen und den neusten LLMs.
  • Du studierst Informatik, Medieninformatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science, Software Engineering oder etwas Vergleichbares (Bachelor oder Master)
  • Du entwickelst in JavaScript oder Python, kennst REST-APIs und hast schon einmal Daten aus einer fremden Quelle in eine eigene Struktur überführt
  • SQL beherrschst du zumindest in den Grundlagen, mit Git arbeitest du selbstverständlich
  • Erfahrung mit Google Cloud, BigQuery oder Looker Studio ist ein Plus – das lernst du bei uns auch on the job
  • Du arbeitest sorgfältig und genau. Du siehst bei uns Zahlen aus Konzernprojekten, teils vor ihrer Veröffentlichung. Ein Fehler in Zeile 400 landet sonst in einer Vorstandspräsentation.
  • Du hast Lust auf ein Thema, für das es noch keine Lehrbücher gibt. GEO ist eine neue Disziplin, einen guten Teil der Methodik definieren wir gerade selbst.
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Du musst nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllen – wichtiger ist uns deine Motivation und Lernbereitschaft!

Benefits

  • Remote-Flexi-Freiheit: Ob irgendwo in Deutschland oder in Köln-Ehrenfeld, ob besonders früh oder ein bisschen später – wo und wann du arbeitest, bestimmst du mit.
  • Sabbatical | Workation: Wenn du mal richtig Fernweh bekommst, dann kannst du europaweit auf Workation gehen. Es soll noch ein bisschen mehr sein? Nimm dir ein Sabbatical.
  • Urlaubs-Paradies: Bei uns gibt’s 30 Tage Urlaub + 2 Goodie-Tage + Sonderurlaub.
  • Innere Werte: Wir halten zusammen und zeigen Wertschätzung. Open-hearted & open-minded – das sind wir im Job, beim Mentoring, bei Teamevents und beim sozialen Engagement.

Als unser (Senior) Legal Counsel (m/w/d) verantwortest du wichtige Teile der Rechtsfunktion von BIT Capital und bist die erste Adresse für alle (aufsichts-) rechtlichen Fragen. Als von der BaFin beaufsichtigtes Institut bewegen wir uns in einem dicht regulierten Umfeld, welches bestimmt, wie wir Produkte auflegen, Portfolios steuern und mit unseren Investoren kommunizieren. Du übersetzt diese Anforderungen in Entscheidungen, die unsere Fachbereiche tatsächlich anwenden können. Du berichtest direkt an Dr. Matthias Thom (Managing Director) und arbeitest in einem schlanken Set-up mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen.

In deiner Rolle fokussierst du dich auf:

  • Aufsichtsrecht. Du berätst unsere Fachbereiche eigenständig in allen aufsichtsrechtlichen Fragestellungen (WpIG, WpHG, KAGB, MaRisk, MaComp, GwG, DORA) und entwickelst unser Internes Kontroll- und Compliance-Management-System in der täglichen Anwendung weiter.
  • Erste Adresse im Haus. Du bist Ansprechpartner:in für Portfolio Management, Investment Operations, Sales, Marketing und HR und gibst pragmatische Handlungsempfehlungen statt Gutachten mit offenem Ausgang.
  • Prüfungen & Behördenkontakt. Du koordinierst in- und externe Prüfungen, führst die Kommunikation mit BaFin sowie Bundesbank und steuerst externe Kanzleien und Berater dort, wo wir spezialisierte Unterstützung brauchen.
  • Regulatorische Funktionen. Du übernimmst regulatorische Mandate, insbesondere die Rolle des stellvertretenden Geldwäschebeauftragten (Deputy MLRO) und des Datenschutzbeauftragten.
  • Neue Produkte & strategische Projekte. Du begleitest die Auflage neuer Fonds mit Kapitalverwaltungsgesellschaften und Depotbanken sowie unsere internationale Expansion rechtlich von der Struktur bis zur Umsetzung.
  • Verträge, Arbeits- und Datenschutzrecht. Du verantwortest das Vertragswesen und berätst in den weiteren Rechtsgebieten, die ein wachsender Asset Manager täglich berührt.


Deine Erfahrung

  • Zwei juristische Staatsexamen mit überdurchschnittlichen Ergebnissen.
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Aufsichtsrecht für Finanzinstitute, erworben in einer Großkanzlei, einer renommierten Boutique oder in-house bei einem regulierten Institut.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit den einschlägigen Regelwerken: WpIG, WpHG, KAGB, MaRisk, MaComp und GwG.
  • Belastbare Kenntnisse in weiteren Rechtsgebieten, insbesondere Vertrags-, Arbeits- und Datenschutzrecht.
  • Du erfasst komplexe aufsichtsrechtliche Sachverhalte schnell, entscheidest eigenständig und begleitest die Umsetzung federführend.
  • Bereitschaft, regulatorische Funktionen persönlich zu übernehmen und die damit verbundene Verantwortung zu tragen.
  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch.


2 Gründe dich nicht zu bewerben

  • Du möchtest dich auf ein einzelnes Rechtsgebiet spezialisieren? Diese Rolle ist bewusst generalistisch angelegt: Neben dem aufsichtsrechtlichen Schwerpunkt liegen Vertrags-, Arbeits- und Datenschutzrecht ebenfalls bei dir.
  • Du arbeitest lieber im Kanzlei-Set-up mit Zuarbeit und mehreren Prüfschleifen? Bei uns bist du die Rechtsfunktion und triffst Entscheidungen selbst. Wir bieten dir dafür viel Gestaltungsfreiraum, unter anderem beim Aufbau einer Junior-Position an deiner Seite.


Dein Mindset

  • Du besitzt eine Leidenschaft für Aktien, Finanzmärkte und Technologie.
  • Du verstehst Regulatorik als Fundament einer gesunden Organisation und nicht als Bremse. Du sagst klar, was geht, was nicht geht und unter welchen Bedingungen.
  • Du nutzt KI-Tools selbstverständlich in deinem Arbeitsalltag und denkst in deinem eigenen Aufgabengebiet konsequent an Automatisierung.
  • Du denkst unternehmerisch und bringst Dinge zu Ende, auch ohne perfekte Rahmenbedingungen. Ein reines 9-to-5-Mindset passt nicht zu dieser Rolle.


Was wir dir bieten

  • Maßgebliche Verantwortung für die Rechtsfunktion eines wachsenden, BaFin-beaufsichtigten Asset Managers: Du gestaltest, statt zu verwalten.
  • Direkte Berichtslinie an Dr. Matthias Thom (Managing Director) und kurze Entscheidungswege in einem Team von 45+ Kolleg:innen aus 15 Nationen.
  • Tiefe Einblicke in Investment Operations und Portfolio Management und damit in die operativen Kernthemen der Finanzindustrie.
  • Perspektive, das Legal-Team mit aufzubauen, und ein Umfeld, in dem das Team signifikant in die eigenen Fonds investiert ist.

jobs.title: Sr. Talent Acquisition Partner (Technical)
jobs.description:
As a Senior Talent Acquisition Partner, Technical at vCluster Labs, you aren't just filling open requisitions, you are the architect of our engineering capability across Europe. In this role, you will serve as the primary ambassador to the technical community, identifying and attracting the builders who will shape the future of vCluster. You will have the unique opportunity to partner directly with Engineering and Product leadership, as one of vCluster Labs' first TA hires on the ground in Europe.

As a Senior Talent Acquisition Partner, Technical, your role will include:

  • Full Cycle Technical Recruiting: Own the end to end hiring process for Engineering, Product, and Technical roles globally. You will guide candidates from the initial talent screen through the offer stage, ensuring a seamless flow.

  • Regional Technical Expertise: Serve as our first EMEA based technical recruiter and build the practices needed to hire engineering talent across the region. You will stay closely aligned with the US based People Ops and Engineering teams while adapting to local market norms.

  • Strategic Sourcing: Proactively source and engage passive talent from the open source, Kubernetes, and developer tool communities, including hard to find software engineers. You will build high quality pipelines so we do not rely solely on inbound applicants for critical technical roles.

  • Data Driven Execution: Champion our structured interview process. You will ensure scorecards are utilized effectively to reduce bias, maintaining strict data integrity within our ATS, Ashby, to inform hiring decisions.

  • Candidate Experience: Drive an exceptional experience by ensuring transparent communication. You will treat candidates with customer centric speed, ensuring decisions are made in days, not months.

  • Partnership: Collaborate with hiring managers to define technical requirements and ideal talent profiles. You will act as a true consultant on market trends and closing strategies for hard to fill engineering roles, not just an order taker.

This role could be a fit for you if you bring:

  • Experience: You have 5+ years of full cycle recruiting experience, specifically for technical roles such as Software Engineering, DevOps or Platform, and Product, within a high growth tech startup.

  • Technical Fluency: You speak the language. You understand the difference between a container and a cluster, and you are comfortable discussing technologies like Kubernetes, Go, and Terraform with candidates.

  • A Track Record on Hard Roles: You have closed genuinely hard to find engineering talent before and know how to build a pipeline when the obvious channels come up empty.

  • Location and Reach: You are based in Germany and ready to be one of vCluster Labs' first hires on the ground in Europe, working across European and US time zones as needed.

  • A Builder Mindset: You are comfortable operating in ambiguity and enjoy refining processes to make them more efficient, especially as you stand up new technical hiring practices for the region.

  • A Data Centric Approach: You value results over tasks. You use data and analytics to track pipeline health and inform decision making.

  • High EQ and Active Listening: You are an effective communicator who genuinely listens to understand the perspectives of both candidates and hiring managers.

Bonus points for:

  • ATS Proficiency: Experience with Ashby.

  • Domain Expertise: Experience recruiting for open source technology, developer tools, or Kubernetes focused companies.

  • Global Reach: A background in hiring for distributed, remote first engineering teams.

  • HR Generalist Background: Experience beyond recruiting, such as HR operations, employee relations, or onboarding, that gives you a broader view of the employee lifecycle.

About vCluster Labs

We are a venture-backed tech startup and the company pioneering Kubernetes virtualization for the AI era. We raised +$30M from top-tier VCs such as Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, Doordash) and are in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to complement our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe and we have a remote-first work culture.

We are the leading platform for operating GPU infrastructure, enabling AI Cloud providers to deliver a hyperscaler-like experience to their customers and AI factories that need to build that same experience for their internal teams. Our platform delivers the full operational stack operators need to run their GPU data centers — managed Kubernetes, fast isolated tenant provisioning, and automated node provisioning and lifecycle management — enabling them to accelerate time to value, reduce operational burden, and maximize the ROI of every GPU.

We're the company behind vCluster, an open-source technology for virtualizing Kubernetes (10k+ GitHub stars, 40M+ virtual clusters created since 2021). Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI — a Kubernetes-native framework purpose-built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

Benefits

We offer the following benefits:

  • Competitive Salary: We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity.

  • Platinum-Level Insurance: Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country).

  • Flexible Working Schedule:  You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day.

  • Workplace Flexibility:  We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way.

Culture & Values

At vCluster Labs, we value and stand for:

  1. Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business.

  2. Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers.

  3. Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights.

  4. Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from.

  5. Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms.
